SEO-агент.d: Finds the queries and writes the pages for them
SEO-агент.full: Collects the keyword set, watches positions and the technical state of the site, finds the queries where you are already close to the top and writes the pages for them. It shows what to fix first by effort against return.
SEO-агент.lim: Does not edit the site code itself
SEO-агент.pain: Free traffic passes you by because nobody has the time for it

Аналитик рекламы.d: Works out payback by channel and combination
Аналитик рекламы.res: You can see which channel brings money
Аналитик рекламы.full: Works out payback by channel and by combination: what a lead cost, how many reached a deal, how much money came back. It answers the question of which channel feeds you and which one just spends the budget elegantly.
Аналитик рекламы.lim: Does not switch campaigns off on its own
Аналитик рекламы.pain: The budget flows out and nobody knows for sure which channel brings the money

Контент-агент.d: Writes posts, articles and newsletters in your voice
Контент-агент.full: Writes in the brand voice: posts, articles, newsletters, descriptions. It keeps the content plan, picks up news hooks from the Radar and produces a draft you correct rather than write from scratch. It remembers what the company never says and the phrasings it likes.
Контент-агент.pain: Content comes out in bursts, whenever someone finds the time

SMM-планировщик.d: Keeps the content plan and posts on schedule
SMM-планировщик.full: Keeps the publishing calendar per platform: what goes out, when and in what format. It queues the posts, watches the rhythm and moves things when the agenda changes.
SMM-планировщик.lim: Does not reply to comments, that belongs to Reputation
SMM-планировщик.pain: Social channels run on mood, there is no rhythm

Копирайтер лендингов.full: Writes selling pages for a specific offer: headline, offer, block structure, objection handling, call to action. It leans on the real words of clients from chats and reviews rather than on generic formulas.
Копирайтер лендингов.lim: Does not build or publish the page
Копирайтер лендингов.pain: Launching a new offer waits in the queue for a copywriter

Дизайнер креативов.d: Generates visuals for ads and social
Дизайнер креативов.res: Creatives without a designer on staff
Дизайнер креативов.full: Generates visuals for ads and social inside the brand: formats per platform, variants to test, size adaptations. It gives several versions so there is something to choose from.
Дизайнер креативов.lim: Does not replace a designer on complex identity work
Дизайнер креативов.pain: Tests are on hold because there are no fresh creatives

Радар новостей.d: Collects market news and story hooks
Радар новостей.res: You always have something to say to the market
Радар новостей.full: Every morning it collects news from the market, the industry and your own topics, cuts the noise and leaves what actually touches the business. It files it and prepares a short digest with hooks for content and for client conversations.
Радар новостей.lim: Does not judge the credibility of sources for you
Радар новостей.pain: You are the last to hear important market news

Репутация и отзывы.full: Monitors brand mentions on review sites, social platforms and maps. It drafts replies in your tone and raises anything negative immediately, without waiting for it to spread.
Репутация и отзывы.pain: A bad review sits unanswered and everyone who searches for you sees it

Конкурентная разведка.res: You read the market before the others
Конкурентная разведка.full: Keeps competitors under observation: prices, offers, launches, job ads, site changes. It signals when someone moves and explains what it threatens or what you can take.
Конкурентная разведка.pain: A competitor changed prices and offers and you found out a month later

База знаний.d: Holds one truth about the product, prices and answers
База знаний.res: Everyone answers the same and correctly
База знаний.full: Holds the single source of truth for the company: product, prices, terms, frequent answers, procedures. It answers both people and agents, notices when an answer is missing and asks for it, so the gap does not stay.
База знаний.lim: Never invents an answer when the information is missing
База знаний.pain: Everyone answers the client their own way, and some of the answers are simply wrong

Служба заботы.d: Takes questions and requests, resolves and escalates
Служба заботы.full: The first line around the clock: it takes questions from every channel, answers from the knowledge base, resolves the routine on the spot and hands the complex cases to a person together with the collected context, so nothing has to be repeated.
Служба заботы.lim: Does not promise refunds or compensation without confirmation
Служба заботы.pain: Questions pile up out of hours and in the morning support is drowning

Апсейл-агент.d: Spots the signals to expand and offers the next step
Апсейл-агент.res: Revenue growth from the base you have
Апсейл-агент.full: Catches the signals to expand: the client hit a limit, grew, asked about an adjacent feature. It prepares the next step with the reasoning for why they need it now.
Апсейл-агент.lim: Does not push extras at anyone who has not seen a result yet
Апсейл-агент.pain: The client grew and bought the expansion elsewhere because you did not offer it

Агент продлений.res: The cheapest revenue is not lost
Агент продлений.full: Watches contracts, memberships and subscriptions coming to an end, prepares the renewal in advance and reminds the client before anything expires. It saves revenue that was already earned and could simply leak away through inattention.
Агент продлений.lim: Never renews automatically without the client's agreement
Агент продлений.pain: The contract expired and the client did not come back, although they were perfectly happy
